signup_ok: Signup successful. Please check your email for the verification code.
verification_code_resent: A new verification code has been sent to your email.
registration_ok: Registered. Your Discord role is on its way.
registration_ok_team: Team registered. Discord roles are on their way.
registration_pending_sponsor: Registered. Your registration is waiting for the sponsor's approval.
registration_waitlisted: Event is full. You have been added to the waitlist.
registration_waitlisted_team: Event is full. Your team has been added to the waitlist.
reset_token_sent: A password reset code has been sent to your email.
reset_token_resent: A new password reset code has been sent to your email.
team_name_needs_letter: A team name needs at least one letter or number.
team_name_reserved: That name belongs to a page on AFC. Please choose another name.
email_invalid: That email address does not look right. Please check it.
claims_not_open_yet: Results for this map open when its group starts playing.
claims_closed: Results for this map are closed: the organizer's time for sending them has passed.
attach_game_file: Attach a debugger or result file.
game_file_too_large: That file is too large to send. Add it again from the box, it compresses it first.
game_file_unreadable: That file is too large or damaged.
not_a_game_file: That is not a debugger file or a match result file.
game_files_ids_required: Send the ids of the files you added.
game_files_expired: These files were read too long ago. Add them again.
game_not_in_files: That game is not in these files.
game_files_bad_choices: The choices for that game could not be read.
placements_not_one_each: Each placement can be used once: 1 for the winner, then 2, 3 and so on.
no_files_for_game: There is nothing to upload for that game.
match_not_on_event: That match is not on this event.
not_an_image: That file is not a picture. Use a JPEG, PNG, WEBP or GIF.
image_too_large: That picture is larger than 10 MB.
create_event_failed: The event could not be created. Nothing was saved; please try again, and tell AFC support if it keeps happening.
whatsapp_check_required: Verify your WhatsApp number to vote in these awards.
whatsapp_number_invalid: That is not a WhatsApp number. Include the country code, like +234.
whatsapp_number_taken: That WhatsApp number already backs another account.
whatsapp_code_wrong: That code is not the one we sent.
whatsapp_code_expired: That code has expired. Ask for a new one.
whatsapp_too_many_codes: Too many codes for now. Try again in an hour.
whatsapp_code_not_sent: The code could not be sent. Try again in a minute.
whatsapp_too_many_tries: Too many wrong codes. Ask for a new one.
whatsapp_inbound_off: Sending a code to AFC is not available. Ask for a code instead.
option_not_found: That nominee is not on this ballot.
game_log_not_result: This is a game log, not a match result file. Add it in Game files: it reads the whole game the way AFC Capture does and asks for any file it still needs.
replay_file_unreadable: That replay file is too large or damaged.
replay_name_needed: Keep the replay file's own name (ReplayInfo_<match>_<date>.bin) so it can be paired with its map.
board_group_not_found: That group is not part of this event.
board_maps_invalid: Maps must be chosen from this group.
session_map_in_progress: A map is being played right now. Mark it once it has ended.
session_done_required: Say whether the last map has been played.
capture_duplicate_game: This game is already on the website as MATCH {match_number} ({map}) in {group}. It was not counted again.
org_name_reserved: That name belongs to someone else, so it cannot be used. Pick another name.
org_name_taken: There is already an organization with that name. Pick another one.
org_name_invalid: Use a name of 3 to 60 characters.
org_country_invalid: Pick the country your organization is based in.
org_description_too_long: Keep the about text under 1,000 characters.
org_email_invalid: That email address does not look right.
org_social_invalid: A social link must be a full https:// address.
org_rules_not_accepted: Read and accept the organizer rules to continue.
org_start_limit: You already run 3 organizations you started. Ask AFC if you need another one.
org_start_rate_limited: You started 3 organizations today. Try again tomorrow.
org_name_check_rate_limited: Too many name checks. Wait a minute and try again.
org_paid_entry_off: Organizers cannot charge an entry fee on AFC for now. Only AFC's own events take payment.
bot_check_failed: The security check did not pass. Wait a moment and try again.
badge_rules_not_met: Every Verified rule must be met first.
badge_partner_needs_verified: An organization is Verified before it can be an AFC Partner.
badge_unchanged: The organization already has that badge.
badge_invalid: Pick Community, Verified or AFC Partner.
rule_tick_invalid: Pick the trophies rule or the community rule.
